If you’re thinking about joining Starz, a free trial is the best way to test out a streaming platform to see if it’s a good fit. However, Starz no longer offers a free trial directly, but we found a clever workaround to watch for free.

Get Starz 7-day Free Trial on Prime Video

You can get Starz for free, as a channel add-on via Prime Video . The streamer is offering a seven-day free trial, if you add Starz to your Amazon account. It’s the best way to watch for free online right now.

Starz

Get Starz

Afterward, Starz, which gives you access to tons of TV shows and movies, goes for $11.99 per month (or $69.99 per year). After the free trial ends, your plan will automatically renew at the regular rate, but you can cancel anytime.

Starz is the home to hit originals, like Outlander , Outlander: Blood of My Blood , BMF ( Black Mafia Family ), Party Down , P-Valley , Sweetpea , The Serpent Queen , S.W.A.T. Exiles , Spartacus , Power , Power Book II: Ghost , Power Book III: Raising Kanan , Power Book IV: Force and others, as well as hot music programming, such as Nas: Time Is Illmatic , Down in the Valley , Whitney Houston in Focus , The BMF Documentary: Blowing Money Fast and more.

The streaming service has a large number of movies too, including Michael (2026) , The Furious , Shelter , In the Grey , Oscar Shaw and others.

You can watch documentary TV shows on Starz, including Men in Kilts: A Roadtrip with Sam and Graham , Seduced: Inside the NXIVM Cult , Confronting a Serial Killer and Fat Joe Talks , as well as an extensive library of cult classics, such as Black Sails , The White Queen and The White Princess , Magic City , Ash vs. Evil Dead and others.
